name: People Who Lie
overview: Scripture reveals that lying is deeply detestable to the Lord, who hates deceit as an abomination. Proverbs contrasts the character of a liar unfavorably even to a poor man, highlighting the moral deficiency of dishonesty. Furthermore, the Apostle Paul lists deceit among the manifestations of a heart filled with unrighteousness, emphasizing that lying is part of a broader pattern of sinful behavior that separates people from God's truth.
